title: euphrasia alpina
intro: Euphrasia alpina, commonly known as Alpine Eyebright, is a small, flowering plant that belongs to the gentian family (Gentianaceae). This herb has been traditionally used to support eye health and respiratory issues due to its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, soothe sore throats, and alleviate symptoms of respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of Euphrasia alpina can be attributed to its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antihistamine properties, which help to calm and protect the mucous membranes. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
